_meta.description: Seed (placeholder) numeric parameters for the Building Seismic-Resilience Credit Model (MKM-SEIS-001). ALL VALUES ARE ENGINEERING-JUDGEMENT SEEDS, not calibrated. They are physically defensible starting points (direction and ordering, not magnitude) intended to be recalibrated against historical seismic-loss data under SEIS-R1. Structure derives from docs/seismic/MKM-SEIS-001-v0.10.md Appendices A, D and E; this module never embeds numbers in code. Zone rates, G-R coefficients, GMPE and V_S30 proxies live in config/seismic_zones.json.

occurrence._doc: Model A — Poisson occurrence and fault spatial draw scalars (Appendix A2 + Section 3.2). Zone-level lambda/b/m_max live in seismic_zones.json; these are the cross-zone constants.

fault_proximity._doc: Appendix A2 — fault proximity modifier. When FaultProximityKm < threshold_km and GS01 (fault distance / seismic design) is ABSENT, the asset occurrence rate is multiplied by (1 + delta_gs01).

wells_coppersmith._doc: Section 3.2 — Wells-Coppersmith surface rupture-length scaling. log10(L_r_km) = a + b * M. The rupture segment occupies [s* - L_r/2, s* + L_r/2] along the fault trace.

fragility._doc: Model D — Appendix E1. Baseline lognormal fragility median PGA (g) per damage state by FRAGILITY CLASS, plus beta (log-standard deviation). The CDM ConstructionType menu is mapped to these classes by the CDM adapter (CONSTRUCTION_FRAGILITY_MAP). Sensitivity harnesses address classes directly.

loss_given_damage_state._doc: Appendix E2 — per-damage-state structural loss ratio L_s, truncated lognormal on [0,1] parameterised by mean and log-std. DS3 is fixed at 1.00 (no draw).

recovery._doc: Appendix E3 — post-event functionality Q(t0) and default recovery time T_rec (months) by damage state. T_rec is divided by r_acc (Model C) to give the effective recovery time. control_horizon_months is T_LC for the resilience-index area-under-Q(t).

response._doc: Model C — Appendix D. Deterministic mapping from present BRI geoseismic measures (GS01-GS18) to fragility median multipliers, the governance cap, the recovery acceleration factor and the post-earthquake-fire probability. A measure with 'applies' = 'all' shifts every damage-state median; otherwise it shifts only the listed states. theta_mult = product over present measures of (1 + delta).

governance._doc: Appendix D1 — governance measures GS16-GS18 each add delta_each to all damage-state medians but share combined_cap to prevent double-counting. GS18 additionally accelerates recovery (see r_acc.gs18_multiplier).

gs02_soil_gate._doc: Section 3.3 — GS02 (seismic foundation design) removes the soft-soil amplification factor F_a (config/seismic_zones.json site_class.soil_amplification) for site classes D/E.

post_earthquake_fire._doc: Appendix E4 / Section 3.6 — conditional probability of a fire cascade given damage state. GS15 (flexible gas piping with automatic seismic shut-off) reduces p_PEF by gs15_reduction. When the cascade fires, the fire model is invoked with InitiationClass = ExternalExposure and the scenario loss is max(L_seismic, L_fire).

conditional_fire_loss._doc: Seed loss-given-cascade L_fire (truncated lognormal on [0,1], median = mean) used when a post-earthquake fire ignites in a DS2/DS3-damaged asset with disrupted suppression. The scenario loss becomes max(L_seismic, L_fire). Placeholder until the full MKM-FIRE-001 coupling (simulate_fire_containment with InitiationClass = ExternalExposure) is wired via the fire_loss_fn hook (SEIS-R1).

recovery_acceleration._doc: Appendix D2 — recovery acceleration factor r_acc by derived BRI geoseismic rating. Effective T_rec = T_rec_default / r_acc. The rating is derived from which measures are present (see grade_code_sets).

grade_code_sets._doc: Section 7.4 Table 5 — BRI geoseismic rating positions used to derive r_acc. A rating is the highest tier whose cumulative measure set is materially present. 'B' = the basic set; 'A' = B plus a_extra; 'AA' = A plus aa_extra. Model C derives the rating from the present measures using these sets.
